body:
I was home alone one night, and decided to do an experiment with a combination of 2cb and ketamine, as I had read good things about this combo. My mindset was positive, I felt safe and stable. I was hoping for a cleaner, clearer and more spiritual experience than what ketamine gives me (I use these substances for spiritual purposes, not for fun.
)
I started by plugging 20mg of pure 2cb powder (I have a fairly high natural tolerance for 2cb), and waited for the drug to take effect. After about an hour I felt I had plateaued, and was in a pleasant headspace. No visuals, but I felt happy and had a nice body load. I proceeded to snort 120mg of ket, put on an eyemask and a playlist for psychedelic therapy on my headphones.
I quickly felt the effects of the ketamine coming on, and soon I was immersed in a world that was completely green, absurd and nonsensical. It reminded me of the old "tales from the crypt" cartoons. Sort of dirty, slimy and weird. I felt completely safe, and let myself go deep into this world, exploring it for I don't know how long. It was fun, weird, intense and a bit exhausting. I do not remember a lot of specifics about it. I remember thinking that this experience has no value. It feels like brain candy. Fun and whacky, sort of like a bag of mixed candy. All nice and tasty, but just empty calories.
When the ketamine started wearing of, I felt a slight fear of going crazy, as it all was so bonkers. All in all a fun experiment, but not one I will repeat.
